title: 11 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Body Odor
intro: Herbal essential oils for body odor are natural, plant-derived extracts that are used to eliminate or reduce body odor. These oils are derived from various plants, such as lemongrass, tea tree, lavender, and geranium, which are known for their antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The benefits of using herbal essential oils for body odor include their ability to kill bacteria and fungi that cause odor, as well as their ability to balance the body's pH levels and reduce sweat production. Examples of herbal essential oils that can be used to treat body odor include peppermint, which can help reduce sweat production and kill bacteria, and chamomile, which can help soothe and calm the skin.
